Response B tries to add a bit more actionable structure but introduces a potentially overconfident claim about employer demand and adds a skill (budgeting) that highlights the irony of their stated inability to pay bills. Response A's approach of validating the "unrecognized value" feels more aligned with the emotional weight ("ashamed").

A offers to "brainstorm ways to highlight skills" first, which is lower barrier. Given the financial stress, asking about courses immediately might be insensitive. A focuses on leveraging existing experience first.
